## Public change

Describe the public dataset, documentation or accessibility change and link the supporting evidence.

## Checklist

- [ ] I updated the dataset card and registry together when facts changed.
- [ ] I ran `npm ci`, `npm run lint`, `npm run check`, `npm run build` and `npm run test:links`.
- [ ] I did not add plugin source, Unreal project files, binaries, private schemas, credentials or local paths.
- [ ] I have the right to publish every submitted image and piece of data.
- [ ] I did not describe the samples as benchmarks, open-source software or perfect ground truth.
